outcome: Serum lipid profile (total cholesterol, triacylglycerol, high-density lipoprotein cholesterol, very low-density lipoprotein cholesterol)
Liver function markers (albumin, aspartate aminotransferase, alanine aminotransferase)
Kidney function markers (urea, creatinine, uric acid)
cohort: Twenty female pregnant rats, some induced with streptozotocin (STZ) to simulate gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), divided into control, diabetic untreated, metformin-treated, and tBHQ-treated groups.
finding: Tert-butylhydroquinone (tBHQ) supplementation mitigated histological changes in the maternal kidney, protected foetal kidneys against oxidative stress, and the foetus against mortality arising from maternal hyperglycaemia in diabetic pregnant rats, with effects comparable to or better than metformin.
birth_weight: Foetal weights were measured and found to be altered in the disease group.
